description.value: This study examined the neural basis of social coordination during conversational exchanges in patients with behavioral variant frontotemporal degeneration and related task performance to gray matter density.

spans.text: In this study, we examine the neural basis for social coordination by studying semi-structured conversational exchanges in patients with behavioral variant of frontotemporal degeneration (bvFTD).
